taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

generator.params.note: From the template, Dicentra formosa, changed for a poppy's form: leafy stems (Flora of North America vol. 3, Eschscholzia: stems leafy; leaves basal and sometimes cauline), so 3 stem leaves 8 cm long over a short bare foot beside 3 basal leaves 15 cm long, inside the model estimate's 5-15 cm leaves, spread at 50 degrees; no arching (arch 0) and the stems leaning out to 20 degrees, for 'erect or spreading'; one flower ending each stem on the stem's top 30 percent, bare, standing for the long peduncle, its stalk 1 cm; flowering from the first year (adult_age 1), as the annual forms do; a bud 1.5 cm. No raceme cluster: the flower is solitary. flower_size is left to the rule from flower_size_m, and stem_height to the rule from height_typical_m. The shading areas are the template's, for the shading test to correct. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.3 m tall at 4 years in the open, inside Flora of North America's 5-60 cm. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours from Flora of North America vol. 3, Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): plants 'glabrous, sometimes glaucous', so a grey blue-green for leaves and stems; petals 'yellow to orange, usually with orange spot at base', a bright orange, its accent a deeper orange.

appearance.organs.leaf.shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): blade 1-4× pinnately deeply lobed, lobes of each order usually 3; ultimate lobes narrow. Drawn on a twice-divided card of narrow lobes (9 primary lobes, each in 3), as yarrow's dissected blades are, since the kingdom's rule would draw a dissected blade on a once-lobed card; the counts and stalk share by hand.

appearance.organs.basal.shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): leaves basal and sometimes cauline, petiolate; blade 1-4× pinnately deeply lobed, lobes of each order usually 3. The template's frond card, pinnae 4 a side, its stalk 0.3 of the leaf as the template had it; counts by hand.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.note: The template's broad petals (petal_width 1.2), now without its raceme cluster, as the flower is solitary. Petal count and whorls are left to the rules from flower_merosity 2 (the family's) and petal_whorls 2, stamens and carpels to theirs.

appearance.organs.fruit.shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): fruits capsular, cylindric; E. californica capsules 3-9 cm. No source read gives the width, so drawn by hand as slender as a fruit look draws (aspect 0.1, a tenth as wide as long), a slender pod; a real one is narrower still.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): plants perennial or annual, caulescent, erect or spreading, 5-60 cm. The typical 30 cm is inside the model estimate's usual 15-50 cm (species-facts-2026-10-15, record L2801972).

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): 5-60 cm.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): plants perennial or annual; taproot heavy in perennial forms.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): herbs, annual or perennial.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2801972), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): leaves alternate, basal and sometimes cauline, petiolate.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): blade 1-4× pinnately deeply lobed (one blade, lobed, not of separate leaflets).

traits.leaf_incision.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): blade 1-4× pinnately deeply lobed, lobes of each order usually 3; ultimate lobes narrow.

traits.division_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): blade 1-4× pinnately deeply lobed.

traits.division_order.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): blade 1-4× pinnately deeply lobed.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2801972), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2801972), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2801972), as no source read gives it; the ultimate lobes' edges.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): plants glabrous, sometimes glaucous.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): inflorescences cymose or 1-flowered; the model estimate (species-facts-2026-10-15, record L2801972) gives solitary. Drawn one flower to a stem; Floral Diagrams (ref floral-2026-10-15#510) draws the cymose form, a central flower flanked by lateral ones.

traits.flower_posture.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2801972), as no source read gives the open flower's; Flora of North America says buds erect.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2801972), as no source read gives it.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): petals 20-60 mm.

traits.petal_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): petals 4, rarely more (doubled flowers), obovate to obcuneate, with satin sheen.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): petals yellow to orange. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_base_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): petals yellow to orange, usually with orange spot at base. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Eschscholzia californica (ref floral-2026-10-15#510): flower disymmetric, two planes of symmetry, read as actinomorphic (the model estimate, record L2801972, agrees).

traits.petal_whorls.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010), Eschscholzia californica (ref floral-2026-10-15#510): petals 4 (2+2), imbricate; with the family's merosity 2, two whorls of two.

traits.hypanthium.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): receptacle dilated, forming cup beneath calyx, sometimes with free rim; perianth and androecium perigynous. E. californica: receptacle obconic, cup with spreading free rim.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): stamens 12-many; Floral Diagrams (ref floral-2026-10-15#510): 4-22, sometimes more, so 22 is the upper bound kept.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): pistil 2-carpellate; Floral Diagrams (ref floral-2026-10-15#510): carpels 2, fused, parietal placentae.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): fruits capsular, cylindric, 2-valved, dehiscing from base along placentas, often explosively.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia californica (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): capsules 3-9 cm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2801972: brown), as no source read gives it.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 3 (1997), Eschscholzia (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): sepals 2, connate, calyptrate, deciduous as unit.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2801972), as no source read gives it.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2801972), as no source read gives it.
